text:
Claire CSM: Quick note  PioneerApps EBR is scheduled for Fri 9:30am PT. We need a single-slide playbook (visual flow + 3 bullets), an "action sprint" live sheet, and a 90s exec-ready blurb. Slides in drive at draft v0.2.
Derek SE: Ill run the demo. Plan: 1 main path + 1 tiny offline fallback (local model). Keep demos <=4m.
Amira AM: Need a compact renewal-risk snapshot for execs. Health dipped ~10% after onboarding delays and an open invoice. Can someone pull tagged tickets (#onboard, #billing) and top reason codes?
Noah Enablement: I will build the action sprint sheet and capture enablement asks + success criteria. Suggest a 25-min rehearsal Thu to assign owners.
deckbot: Uploaded: https://drive.redwood.com/pioneer/ebr_draft_v0.2  comments on slide 1 and slide notes.
Claire CSM: Derek, in notes add: "Fallback: switch to quantized model if p95 > 300ms" and a 1-line contingency: "play offline GIF if streaming fails."
Derek SE: ack. Will add step-by-step runbook bullets and a 45s offline GIF. Also prepping a one-command smoke check script for infra flakiness.
Amira AM: Short risk breakdown I propose to paste on exec slide: (1) onboarding backlog, (2) SLA gap on batch ingest, (3) billing dispute. I'll draft a 2-line blurb with mitigations and confidence levels.
Noah Enablement: Action sprint template: `Owner | Task | Due | Priority | Status | Follow-up owner | Confidence`. I'll make it editable to owners and view-only for execs.
Claire CSM: Add a "Severity" tag (P0/P1) and a col for "Expected SLA". Slide polish deadline Wed EOD; rehearsal Thu 11am PT. Call out conflicts now.
Amira AM: I have a conflict during the rehearsal window  I'll record a 90s voice note and upload it to the deck comments.
Derek SE: Engineering ask: @eng-runtime, can we get 12 bullets on recent perf variance for slide notes? I'll loop them into the rehearsal invite.
Noah Enablement: Live sheet link (initial): https://sheets.redwood.com/pioneer-ebr-actions  populating rows now and pinging owners. Will add a column for "Owner confirmation".
Claire CSM: Also plan a 2-min "what success looks like" opener for the customer and a 30s exec cue. Keeping everything tight.
Amira AM: I'll paste the renewal-risk blurb and suggested mitigation owners by EOD tomorrow.
Derek SE: I'll preload local assets on a laptop and bring a short offline demo that needs zero network.
Noah Enablement: After rehearsal we triage actions by priority and set SLAs. I'll export the live feed as a one-slide table for the exec pack.
Claire CSM: Thanks team. Drop the live-sheet link in deck comments and ping owners when rows are assigned. :thumbsup:
